purpose_context: Phase 4 shipped the mixer strip bank by rendering each of the sixteen track columns as a generic section of every control the projection carries for that track. The design file authors something else: one column is a track header, a single full-height fader, a hex value readout, a compact pan readout, and one state line. The shipped column stacks four labelled controls and two OFF rows instead, which is why the mixer reads as a spreadsheet rather than as a mixing desk. This mission replaces the generic list with the authored composite. Pan, mute and solo stay focusable and adjustable; only how they are drawn changes.
purpose_tldr: Rebuild the mixer track column as the column the design file authors, instead of a generic list of every control the projection reports.
